decisions.reason: The existing same-message MODIFY already captures the expressly stated extension of the machine's fun, attention-grabbing visual purpose from live events to the client's shop; no additional or corrected Event is needed.

The existing same-message MODIFY already represents the retail context for the DJ-style visual detailing discussed in the immediately preceding exchange; the source entails no further value, removal, or scope change.
The existing same-message MODIFY already includes RETAIL, and the source's references to the beige shipment and green-button base do not establish any additional color change.

The existing same-message MODIFY already captures the retail context associated with using the visually branded machine in the shop; message 191 does not change any branding text, logo, placard, or placement attribute.
The decision to make the machine a fun element at events or in the shop does not change bowl capacity, bowl form, or the mixing scope.
Message 191 does not address bowl removal, swapping, cleaning access, or food-service operation, so the decorative-lighting scope change does not necessarily alter this Requirement.
The source does not change spout geometry, orientation, construction, or dispensing context.
The source concerns visual appeal, shipment timing, and enclosure-base dimensions, not splash behavior or high-speed mixing controls.

The client's height question concerns the machine enclosure section containing the green and power button, not the separate 5.5-inch cup-clearance platform, and it establishes no new platform specification.
The client asks whether enclosure dimensions could change if the base is remade but makes no confirmed layout or CAD decision, so propagation would require a later client determination.
The decorative retail-use statement and enclosure-height questions do not change plumbing sealing, liquid containment, or electrical separation requirements.
Message 191 does not address whisk selection, dimensions, attachment, removal, operating depth, or cleaning scope.
